name: All Star Bulk Order Block
description: All Star Embroidery Gutenberg bulk-order workflow with WooCommerce and ASE Supplier Sync compatibility.
changelog:
1.1.9

  • Upgrades the existing post-checkout artwork uploader into a complete customer/admin review workflow.
  • Adds Artwork Needed, Awaiting Review, Changes Requested, and Approved states.
  • Emails the team on new/revised artwork submissions and emails customers on approval or requested changes.
  • Adds a native WooCommerce ASBO Artwork Review panel with secure file preview/download, review history, and approval controls.
  • Reuses existing artwork order metadata so current uploads remain attached.
  • No pricing, Supplier Sync, cart, shipping, or checkout pricing behavior changed.
